title: Sheet pan chicken and green beans with lemon feta

source.name: Bites with Bri: Sheet Pan Chicken & Green Beans

ingredients: 1 cup olive oil, divided (1/3 cup for the pans, 2/3 cup for the topping)
2 tbsp salt (less if using table salt: 1 tbsp)
1 1/2 tbsp each oregano, smoked paprika and cumin

steps.do: Heat the oven to 425 F. Split the chicken and green beans between 2 sheet pans and toss with the oil, garlic, half the lemon juice, salt, oregano, smoked paprika, cumin and pepper. Spread in one layer.
Bake 20 to 25 min, swapping the pans halfway, until the chicken reaches 165 F.
Meanwhile stir the feta, parsley, dill, the rest of the oil, the lemon zest, the rest of the juice and a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl. Spoon over the chicken and beans.

changes: Scaled about 3x for 8 portions at 40g+ protein; 2 sheet pans.
Skinless thighs so it's quick and not greasy.
Table salt amount halved from the kosher-salt amount.
